proposal.summary: The Administrator section of the Surveillance module in Global RADAR - BSA Radar 1.6.7234.X and lower allows authenticated users with valid privileges to download arbitrary local files from the web server by manipulating the FileName (and FilePath) parameters to UC/downloadFile.ashx, enabling local file inclusion and disclosure of sensitive server files.
proposal.cwe_quote: a user is able to view local files on the web server by manipulating the FileName and FilePath parameters in the URL

AV.quote: When downloading the files, a user is able to view local files on the web server by manipulating the FileName and FilePath parameters in the URL

PR.quote: The current user is required to have valid privileges to send requests to the target vulnerable endpoint.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue using a valid account with the described privileges against /UC/downloadFile.ashx and confirm path traversal; if confirmed, implement server-side validation/whitelisting of filenames, canonicalize and restrict paths to an approved directory, and apply a patch or mitigation to prevent arbitrary file reads.
